payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all possible values of x (1..n), compute y,z,w using constraints from a,b,c,d, check if within [1,n], and multiply count by n.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a complete search over the free variable x, deriving the other unknown cells via equations from the given constraints. While not recursive, it exhaustively enumerates possibilities with pruning (bounds check), fitting the broad backtracking paradigm in this context.
